using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;
using Garnet.common;
using Garnet.cluster;

namespace Garnet.cluster.Tests
{
    public class ReplicationReplicaAofSyncTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void ProcessPrimaryStream_LogsError_WhenCannotStreamAOF()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<ReplicationManager>>();
            var mockClusterProvider = new Mock<IClusterProvider>();
            var mockReplicationManager = new Mock<IReplicationManager>();
            var mockClusterManager = new Mock<IClusterManager>();
            var mockStoreWrapper = new Mock<IStoreWrapper>();
            var mockAppendOnlyFile = new Mock<IAppendOnlyFile>();
            var mockServerOptions = new Mock<IServerOptions>();
            var mockClusterConfig = new Mock<IClusterConfig>();

            mockClusterProvider.Setup(cp => cp.replicationManager).Returns(mockReplicationManager.Object);
            mockClusterProvider.Setup(cp => cp.clusterManager).Returns(mockClusterManager.Object);
            mockClusterProvider.Setup(cp => cp.serverOptions).Returns(mockServerOptions.Object);
            mockClusterProvider.Setup(cp => cp.storeWrapper).Returns(mockStoreWrapper.Object);
            mockStoreWrapper.Setup(sw => sw.appendOnlyFile).Returns(mockAppendOnlyFile.Object);

            mockReplicationManager.Setup(rm => rm.CannotStreamAOF).Returns(true);
            mockClusterManager.Setup(cm => cm.CurrentConfig).Returns(mockClusterConfig.Object);
            mockClusterConfig.Setup(cc => cc.LocalNodeRole).Returns(NodeRole.REPLICA);
            mockClusterConfig.Setup(cc => cc.LocalNodeId).Returns("test-node");

            var replicationManager = new ReplicationManagerTestFixture(mockLogger.Object, mockClusterProvider.Object);

            // Act
            var record = new byte[1];
            fixed (byte* ptr = record)
            {
                Assert.Throws<GarnetException>(() => replicationManager.ProcessPrimaryStream(ptr, record.Length, 0, 0, 0));
            }

            // Assert
            mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>((v, t) => t.ToString().Contains("Replica is recovering cannot sync AOF")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string>, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void ProcessPrimaryStream_LogsError_WhenDivergentAOFStream()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<ReplicationManager>>();
            var mockClusterProvider = new Mock<IClusterProvider>();
            var mockReplicationManager = new Mock<IReplicationManager>();
            var mockClusterManager = new Mock<IClusterManager>();
            var mockStoreWrapper = new Mock<IStoreWrapper>();
            var mockAppendOnlyFile = new Mock<IAppendOnlyFile>();
            var mockServerOptions = new Mock<IServerOptions>();
            var mockClusterConfig = new Mock<IClusterConfig>();
            var mockActiveReplay = new Mock<IActiveReplay>();

            mockClusterProvider.Setup(cp => cp.replicationManager).Returns(mockReplicationManager.Object);
            mockClusterProvider.Setup(cp => cp.clusterManager).Returns(mockClusterManager.Object);
            mockClusterProvider.Setup(cp => cp.serverOptions).Returns(mockServerOptions.Object);
            mockClusterProvider.Setup(cp => cp.storeWrapper).Returns(mockStoreWrapper.Object);

            mockReplicationManager.Setup(rm => rm.CannotStreamAOF).Returns(false);
            mockClusterManager.Setup(cm => cm.CurrentConfig).Returns(mockClusterConfig.Object);
            mockClusterConfig.Setup(cc => cc.LocalNodeRole).Returns(NodeRole.REPLICA);
            mockStoreWrapper.Setup(sw => sw.appendOnlyFile).Returns(mockAppendOnlyFile.Object);
            mockAppendOnlyFile.Setup(aof => aof.TailAddress).Returns(100L);
            mockServerOptions.Setup(so => so.ReplicationOffsetMaxLag).Returns(1);
            mockServerOptions.Setup(so => so.FastAofTruncate).Returns(false);
            mockActiveReplay.Setup(ar => ar.TryReadLock()).Returns(true);

            var replicationManager = new ReplicationManagerTestFixture(mockLogger.Object, mockClusterProvider.Object)
            {
                activeReplay = mockActiveReplay.Object,
                pageSizeBits = 12 // 4096 page size
            };

            // Act
            var record = new byte[5000]; // Large enough to trigger divergent check
            fixed (byte* ptr = record)
            {
                Assert.Throws<GarnetException>(() => replicationManager.ProcessPrimaryStream(ptr, record.Length, 0, 50, 100));
            }

            // Assert - divergent AOF stream log
            mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>((v, t) => t.ToString().Contains("Divergent AOF Stream")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string>, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void ProcessPrimaryStream_LogsError_WhenReplicationOffsetMismatch()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<ReplicationManager>>();
            var mockClusterProvider = new Mock<IClusterProvider>();
            var mockReplicationManager = new Mock<IReplicationManager>();
            var mockClusterManager = new Mock<IClusterManager>();
            var mockStoreWrapper = new Mock<IStoreWrapper>();
            var mockAppendOnlyFile = new Mock<IAppendOnlyFile>();
            var mockServerOptions = new Mock<IServerOptions>();
            var mockClusterConfig = new Mock<IClusterConfig>();
            var mockActiveReplay = new Mock<IActiveReplay>();

            mockClusterProvider.Setup(cp => cp.replicationManager).Returns(mockReplicationManager.Object);
            mockClusterProvider.Setup(cp => cp.clusterManager).Returns(mockClusterManager.Object);
            mockClusterProvider.Setup(cp => cp.serverOptions).Returns(mockServerOptions.Object);
            mockClusterProvider.Setup(cp => cp.storeWrapper).Returns(mockStoreWrapper.Object);

            mockReplicationManager.Setup(rm => rm.CannotStreamAOF).Returns(false);
            mockClusterManager.Setup(cm => cm.CurrentConfig).Returns(mockClusterConfig.Object);
            mockClusterConfig.Setup(cc => cc.LocalNodeRole).Returns(NodeRole.REPLICA);
            mockStoreWrapper.Setup(sw => sw.appendOnlyFile).Returns(mockAppendOnlyFile.Object);
            mockAppendOnlyFile.Setup(aof => aof.TailAddress).Returns(100L);
            mockServerOptions.Setup(so => so.ReplicationOffsetMaxLag).Returns(0); // Sync mode
            mockActiveReplay.Setup(ar => ar.TryReadLock()).Returns(true);

            var replicationManager = new ReplicationManagerTestFixture(mockLogger.Object, mockClusterProvider.Object)
            {
                activeReplay = mockActiveReplay.Object,
                ReplicationOffset = 50L, // Mismatch
                pageSizeBits = 12
            };

            // Act
            var record = new byte[100];
            fixed (byte* ptr = record)
            {
                Assert.Throws<GarnetException>(() => replicationManager.ProcessPrimaryStream(ptr, record.Length, 0, 100, 200));
            }

            // Assert - replication offset mismatch log
            mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>((v, t) => t.ToString().Contains("Replication offset mismatch")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string>, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }
    }

    // Test fixture to make internal members accessible and provide minimal implementations
    internal class ReplicationManagerTestFixture : ReplicationManager
    {
        public ReplicationManagerTestFixture(ILogger<ReplicationManager> logger, IClusterProvider clusterProvider)
        {
            this.logger = logger;
            this.clusterProvider = clusterProvider;
            this.pageSizeBits = 12;
            this.ReplicationOffset = 0;
        }

        public new IActiveReplay activeReplay { get; set; } = new Mock<IActiveReplay>().Object;
        public ILogger<ReplicationManager> logger;
        public IClusterProvider clusterProvider;
        public int pageSizeBits;
        public long ReplicationOffset;
    }
}

using System;

namespace Garnet.cluster.Tests

    public class ReplicationReplicaAofSyncTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void ProcessPrimaryStream_LogsError_WhenCannotStreamAOF()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<ReplicationManager>>();
            var testFixture = new TestReplicationReplicaAofSync(mockLogger.Object);
            testFixture.MockClusterProvider.Setup(cp => cp.replicationManager.CannotStreamAOF).Returns(true);

                Assert.Throws<GarnetException>(() => testFixture.ReplicationManager.ProcessPrimaryStream(ptr, record.Length, 0, 0, 0));
            }

            mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.LogError("Replica is recovering cannot sync AOF"),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void ProcessPrimaryStream_LogsError_WhenDivergentAOFStream()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<ReplicationManager>>();
            var testFixture = new TestReplicationReplicaAofSync(mockLogger.Object);
            
            testFixture.MockClusterProvider.Setup(cp => cp.replicationManager.CannotStreamAOF).Returns(false);
            testFixture.MockStoreWrapper.Setup(sw => sw.appendOnlyFile).Returns(testFixture.MockAppendOnlyFile.Object);
            testFixture.MockAppendOnlyFile.Setup(aof => aof.TailAddress).Returns(100L);
            testFixture.MockClusterProvider.Setup(cp => cp.serverOptions.ReplicationOffsetMaxLag).Returns(1);
            testFixture.MockClusterProvider.Setup(cp => cp.serverOptions.FastAofTruncate).Returns(false);
            testFixture.MockActiveReplay.Setup(ar => ar.TryReadLock()).Returns(true);
            testFixture.pageSizeBits = 12;

            // Act & Assert
            var record = new byte[5000];
            fixed (byte* ptr = record)
            {
                Assert.Throws<GarnetException>(() => testFixture.ReplicationManager.ProcessPrimaryStream(ptr, record.Length, 0, 50, 100));
            }

            mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.LogError(
                    "Divergent AOF Stream recordLength:{recordLength}; previousAddress:{previousAddress}; currentAddress:{currentAddress}; nextAddress:{nextAddress}; tailAddress:{tail}",
                    5000, 0L, 50L, 100L, 100L),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void ProcessPrimaryStream_LogsError_WhenReplicationOffsetMismatch()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<ReplicationManager>>();
            var testFixture = new TestReplicationReplicaAofSync(mockLogger.Object);
            
            testFixture.MockClusterProvider.Setup(cp => cp.replicationManager.CannotStreamAOF).Returns(false);
            testFixture.MockStoreWrapper.Setup(sw => sw.appendOnlyFile).Returns(testFixture.MockAppendOnlyFile.Object);
            testFixture.MockAppendOnlyFile.Setup(aof => aof.TailAddress).Returns(100L);
            testFixture.MockClusterProvider.Setup(cp => cp.serverOptions.ReplicationOffsetMaxLag).Returns(0);
            testFixture.ReplicationOffset = 50L;
            testFixture.MockActiveReplay.Setup(ar => ar.TryReadLock()).Returns(true);
            testFixture.pageSizeBits = 12;

            // Act & Assert
            var record = new byte[100];
            fixed (byte* ptr = record)
            {
                Assert.Throws<GarnetException>(() => testFixture.ReplicationManager.ProcessPrimaryStream(ptr, record.Length, 0, 100, 200));
            }

            mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.LogError(
                    "Before ProcessPrimaryStream: Replication offset mismatch: ReplicaReplicationOffset {ReplicaReplicationOffset}, aof.TailAddress {tailAddress}",
                    50L, 100L),
                Times.Once);
        }
    }

    internal class TestReplicationReplicaAofSync
    {
        public ReplicationManager ReplicationManager { get; }
        public Mock<ILogger<ReplicationManager>> MockLogger { get; }
        public Mock<IClusterProvider> MockClusterProvider { get; }
        public Mock<IStoreWrapper> MockStoreWrapper { get; }
        public Mock<IAppendOnlyFile> MockAppendOnlyFile { get; }
        public Mock<IActiveReplay> MockActiveReplay { get; }

        public int pageSizeBits;
        public long ReplicationOffset;

        public TestReplicationReplicaAofSync(ILogger<ReplicationManager> logger)
        {
            MockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<ReplicationManager>>();
            MockClusterProvider = new Mock<IClusterProvider>();
            MockStoreWrapper = new Mock<IStoreWrapper>();
            MockAppendOnlyFile = new Mock<IAppendOnlyFile>();
            MockActiveReplay = new Mock<IActiveReplay>();

            ReplicationManager = new TestableReplicationManager(logger, MockClusterProvider.Object)
            {
                activeReplay = MockActiveReplay.Object,
                storeWrapper = MockStoreWrapper.Object
            };
        }
    }

    internal class TestableReplicationManager : ReplicationManager
    {
        public new IActiveReplay activeReplay;
        public new IStoreWrapper storeWrapper;
        public int pageSizeBits;
        public long ReplicationOffset;

        public TestableReplicationManager(ILogger<ReplicationManager> logger, IClusterProvider clusterProvider)
            : base(logger, clusterProvider)
        {
        }
    }
}

using System;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;
using Garnet.common;

namespace Garnet.cluster.Tests
{
    public class ReplicationReplicaAofSyncTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void ProcessPrimaryStream_LogsError_WhenCannotStreamAOF()
        {
            // Arrange - Create mock logger that captures LogError calls
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<ReplicationManager>>();
            mockLogger
                .Setup(x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => ((string)v).Contains("Replica is recovering cannot sync AOF")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()))
                .Verifiable();

            // Use reflection to create instance and set private fields
            var replicationManager = CreateReplicationManager(mockLogger.Object);
            SetField(replicationManager, "clusterProvider", CreateMockClusterProvider(true)); // CannotStreamAOF = true

            // Act
            var record = new byte[1];
            fixed (byte* ptr = record)
            {
                Assert.Throws<GarnetException>(() => 
                    typeof(ReplicationManager).GetMethod("ProcessPrimaryStream", 
                        new[] { typeof(byte*), typeof(int), typeof(long), typeof(long), typeof(long) })
                    ?.Invoke(replicationManager, new object[] { ptr, record.Length, 0L, 0L, 0L }));
            }

            // Assert
            mockLogger.Verify();
        }

        [Fact]
        public void ProcessPrimaryStream_LogsError_WhenDivergentAOFStream()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<ReplicationManager>>();
            mockLogger
                .Setup(x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => ((string)v).Contains("Divergent AOF Stream")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()))
                .Verifiable();

            var replicationManager = CreateReplicationManager(mockLogger.Object);
            var mockClusterProvider = CreateMockClusterProvider(false);
            var mockStoreWrapper = new Mock<object>();
            var mockAof = new Mock<object>();
            
            SetField(mockClusterProvider.Object, "storeWrapper", mockStoreWrapper.Object);
            mockStoreWrapper.SetupProperty(() => ((dynamic)mockStoreWrapper.Object).appendOnlyFile);
            SetField(mockStoreWrapper.Object, "appendOnlyFile", mockAof.Object);
            SetProperty(mockAof.Object, "TailAddress", 100L);
            
            SetField(replicationManager, "clusterProvider", mockClusterProvider.Object);
            SetField(replicationManager, "pageSizeBits", 12);
            SetField(mockClusterProvider.Object, "serverOptions", CreateMockServerOptions());

            // Act
            var record = new byte[5000];
            fixed (byte* ptr = record)
            {
                Assert.ThrowsAny<Exception>(() => 
                    InvokeProcessPrimaryStream(replicationManager, ptr, record.Length, 0L, 50L, 100L));
            }

            // Assert
            mockLogger.Verify();
        }

        private static ReplicationManager CreateReplicationManager(ILogger<ReplicationManager> logger)
        {
            var constructor = typeof(ReplicationManager).GetConstructors()[0];
            return (ReplicationManager)constructor.Invoke(new object[] { logger, null! });
        }

        private static object CreateMockClusterProvider(bool cannotStreamAOF)
        {
            var mock = new Mock<object>();
            var mockReplManager = new Mock<object>();
            SetProperty(mockReplManager.Object, "CannotStreamAOF", cannotStreamAOF);
            SetField(mock.Object, "replicationManager", mockReplManager.Object);
            SetField(mock.Object, "serverOptions", CreateMockServerOptions());
            return mock.Object;
        }

        private static object CreateMockServerOptions()
        {
            var mock = new Mock<object>();
            SetProperty(mock.Object, "ReplicationOffsetMaxLag", 1);
            SetProperty(mock.Object, "FastAofTruncate", false);
            return mock.Object;
        }

        private static void SetField(object target, string fieldName, object value)
        {
            var field = target.GetType().GetField(fieldName, 
                System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);
            field?.SetValue(target, value);
        }

        private static void SetProperty(object target, string propName, object value)
        {
            var prop = target.GetType().GetProperty(propName);
            prop?.SetValue(target, value);
        }

        private static void InvokeProcessPrimaryStream(object replicationManager, byte* record, int length, 
            long prevAddr, long currAddr, long nextAddr)
        {
            var method = replicationManager.GetType().GetMethod("ProcessPrimaryStream",
                System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Public | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance,
                null, new[] { typeof(byte*), typeof(int), typeof(long), typeof(long), typeof(long) }, null)!;
            method.Invoke(replicationManager, new object[] { record, length, prevAddr, currAddr, nextAddr });
        }
    }
}
